additional_info.subject: RE: 0378117 - ID0378117-DC/SIC-D/FR [MP/R4 170001741] - HMI issue CRM:02023000130
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-FR Team,
According to the issue reported, the charger screen is black.
Taking the recommended steps should help in resolving the issue.
Could you please confirm if the DP (Display Port) cable has been changed with a new one?
Could you please confirm if the D-logic firmware has been updated to the charger, if not we shall update it.
We need to check the power supply to the control board if there is 24VDC on the cables, but the display controller PCB is not powering ON, we need to replace the complete HMI with the generation2.
Also, you may refer below work instruction for black screen issue.
Please find the work instruction for black screen issue and if you need any help, please reach out to us.
SI E Q-Feedback Q2301 Sicharge D - HMI Blackout Due To RFID Illumination - ID: 109816643 - Industry Support Siemens
:
Refer this Q Feedback if HMI have blackout issue.
SI E Q-Feedback Q2302 Sicharge D - HMI Backlight Off and Scrambled Image Due to R... - ID: 109816666 - Industry Support Siemens
:  Refer this Q feedback if HMI has backlight off
